# Transition Bank (TEST FIXTURE)

A thin set so writing skills have transitions to pull. Banned phrases section
exists so the slop check has something to test against.

## Section 1: hook-forward

- HF-1: "But here is what nobody tells you."
- HF-2: "So let me show you what actually changed it."

## Section 2: segment-to-segment

- SS-1: "Which brings up the second piece."
- SS-2: "That handles the what. Here is the how."

## Section 3: body-to-ending

- BE-1: "So where does that leave you this week?"

## Section 4: banned phrases (never use)

- "without further ado"
- "at the end of the day"
- "let's dive in"
- "in this video I'm going to"
